'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Jerry Heine LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
